issue.title: Bug: [Chassis] MultiAsics support is needed for test_dip_sip testcases in ipfwd suite

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The newly added testcases in ipfwd suite (ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py::test_ipv4_forwarding) fail in MultiAsics chassis.  MultiAsics support is required.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/17058


Run ipfwd suites for the newly added testcases:
ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py::test_ipv4_forwarding

resolution.title: [multi-asic] Add multi-asic support for test_dip_sip
resolution.description: Summary: - add multi-asic support for testcases in [test_dip_sip.py](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py) - refactor code to use sonic CLI for route addition/deletion Fixes [#19769 ](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/19769) ### Type of change - [x] Bug fix - [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement) - [ ] New Test case - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms - [x] Test case improvement ### Back port request - [ ] 202205 - [ ] 202305 - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [ ] 202411 - [ ] 202505 - [x] 202511 ### Approach #### What is the motivation for this PR? Multi-asic support was missing for test cases in test_dip_sip.py #### How did you do it? - Add mutli-asic support for route check, addition and deletion. - Enhanced test cases to use SONiC CLI #### How did you verify/test it? Run tests on single-asic and multi-asic DUTs #### Any platform specific information? #### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case? ### Documentation
